body:
Two real, queued bug reports fixed.

1. "nerd tree needs to scroll with mouse wheel if im hovering over
   nerd tree vs hovering over text editor". Mouse wheel used to always
   scroll the code buffer regardless of cursor position. Added
   file_tree_scroll_offset; the MouseWheel handler now checks the
   same real sidebar hit-test the file-tree's own MouseDown handler
   already uses, routing the wheel to whichever pane the cursor is
   over. Click handling and rendering both fold in the offset so
   clicks still target the correct entry; navigating resets scroll.

2. "ctrl t needs to scroll when you do down and it scrolls past the
   view". Root cause: spotlight_selected was clamped to the real
   result count but the render loop always drew rows 0-11 with no
   scroll offset -- pressing Down past row 11 moved the real
   selection off-screen with nothing visible changing. Added
   spotlight_scroll_offset + spotlight_keep_selection_visible, called
   at every site that changes spotlight_selected; the render loop now
   iterates from the scroll offset.

Full local suite (336 tests) clean, zero regressions. CI green on all
4 jobs.
